sources.finding: Official final gamebook establishes the final 30-27 score, lineups, substitutions, DNPs, inactives, participation, regulation duration and play-by-play injury timing. It records Rashee Rice doubtful after a first-quarter exit; Jalen Nailor injured at 5:30 Q2, returned at 1:17 Q2, then ruled out at 11:32 Q3; Ashton Jeanty injured at 3:08 Q3 and returned at 14:41 Q4; Tyquan Thornton injured at 3:35 Q4; and Trey Zuhn questionable at 2:23 Q1 and returned at 11:52 Q3.
Official Chiefs inactive list identifies Jared Wiley, emergency third QB Garrett Nussmeier, Jadon Canady, Jack Pyburn, Diego Pounds and injury-out Josh Simmons.
Official final injury report rules Josh Simmons out and shows the other listed Chiefs active players had no game designation after full participation.
Official Raiders inactive list identifies emergency third QB Aidan O Connell, Darrell Luter Jr., Tristin McCollum, injury-out Jackson Powers-Johnson and Jonah Laulu.
Official final injury report rules Jackson Powers-Johnson out, treats Aidan O Connell as non-injury personal, and records the remaining listed Raiders without final injury designations.
Official Chiefs depth chart binds Josh Simmons to Kahlil Benson and the receiver reserve identities used only for added vacant duties.

Official Week 4 Raiders depth chart binds Jackson Powers-Johnson to Caleb Rogers, Jalen Nailor to Malik Benson, Ashton Jeanty to Mike Washington Jr., and the available offensive-line reserves reviewed for Trey Zuhn III.
Contemporaneous reporting identifies Rice injury on the first play of the Chiefs second possession and no return, and identifies Thornton injury on the official 3:35 Q4 reception with no return.
